$comment: Role lenses for exec:review (doc 34 W10). Deterministic: no role is a model call. A role is a stage-bound checklist that switches on for the paths and words it owns. 'spec' roles write the cited Executive Assessment before code (CPO and CTO on every R2+ task, the rest when triggered; --check enforces citation and requiredFields). 'gates' items are what the machine already enforces. 'review' items go to the fresh reviewer, triggered by the diff's paths only (exec:review --review). 'launch' items apply to R3+ routes. Checklist items come only from sources the repo treats as binding: AGENTS.md section 4, docs 05/16/18/19, and the named standards. Every vendor in infra/inventory/systems.ts must have its officialDocs hosts listed here (infra/inventory/systems.test.ts).

roles.title: Chief Technology Officer
roles.framework: Architecture decision record: at least two options compared, trade-offs, reversibility (one-way vs two-way door)
ownerGates: One-way-door decisions (irreversible or costly to undo)

roles.title: Chief Financial Officer (FinOps)
roles.framework: FinOps Framework: unit cost per request, CI minutes, vendor plan limits, budget alerts
ownerGates: Any new recurring cost or plan change

review: Tier limits and credit costs are read from TIERS / AI_CREDIT_COSTS in lib/config/constants.ts rather than restated as literals (§4 rule 6)
Any balance or remaining-credit figure shown to a user is computed from the ledger value it claims to show, including zero (L-056, L-069)
A new model call, workflow job or vendor plan states its per-request or monthly cost in the spec

roles.title: Chief Information Security Officer
roles.framework: OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 2; OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025; OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026; NIST SSDF (§A #116)
ownerGates: Weakening any control; new secret or credential scope

review: A paywall response is apiError(402, ErrorCodes.PAYMENT_REQUIRED, ...) (§4 rule 6; gate: check:rules paywall-403)
Every exported 'use server' function establishes its caller with auth() itself rather than trusting a userId argument (§4 rule 4b; gate: check:server-actions)
Secrets and webhook signatures are compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual, and credential modules import 'server-only' (§4 rule 4b)
Auth, ownership, credit settlement and input validation fail closed; a deliberate fail-open path says why in a comment (§4 rule 6)
A new unauthenticated route is listed in proxy.ts on purpose, and every request/response boundary is Zod-validated (§4 rule 4)

roles.title: General Counsel / Privacy
roles.framework: India DPDP Act 2023 + DPDP Rules 2025; GDPR/UK GDPR; EU consumer law; vendor terms and DPAs; infra/inventory/systems.ts as the processor list
ownerGates: Every legal conclusion before launch; published legal text gets one human lawyer review before paid launch

roles.title: DevOps / Site Reliability
roles.framework: Google SRE (SLOs, error budgets, §A #108); DORA metrics; HashiCorp Terraform practice; CIS Google Cloud benchmark

launch: Rollback: the revert target (commit or previous deploy) is named, and reverting needs no data repair
Feature flag: user-visible behaviour can be switched off without a deploy, or the PR says why it cannot
Migration compatibility: the schema change is additive or expand-then-contract, so the previous deploy still runs against it; production runs only through the db-migrate Action
Monitoring: the signal that shows this failing in production (log, metric, alert or SLO) is named

roles.title: Design / UX lead
roles.framework: docs/product/18-design-system.md and the app/globals.css tokens; WCAG 2.2 AA; AGENTS.md §4 rules 2 and 4c; docs/engineering/19-quality-bar.md §3.9
ownerGates: A new visual direction, palette or font pairing (doc 18 wins over any generated design file)

review: Every control has a programmatic label (<label htmlFor> or aria-label), toggle groups expose aria-pressed/aria-selected, and there is one canonical control per state (§4 rule 4c)
Focus is visible through :focus-visible; no bare outline: none (§4 rule 4c)
Colours, spacing and type come from app/globals.css tokens (§4 rule 2; gates: check:tokens, raw-hex)
Motion animates transform and opacity only, lists transition properties explicitly, and respects prefers-reduced-motion (§4 rule 2)
Text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large and UI parts), including over gradients and images (L-032)
Important or frequent touch targets are at least 44x44 and layout follows the 4px rhythm (doc 19 §3.9, §A #48/#49)
Images set explicit dimensions or an aspect ratio, so nothing shifts on load (§4 rule 4d)
The screenshot shows the requested state at the stated viewport and theme, with nothing truncated or overflowing

roles.title: QA lead
roles.framework: docs/engineering/19-quality-bar.md (completion states, evidence packet, failure-mode register); AGENTS.md §6 step 4 and §7
ownerGates: Shipping with a known failing check or a skipped runtime flow

gates: tsc and the tests for changed files pass (Stop hook, then gate:quick before push)
Every evidence type the changed paths owe has a current receipt (check-evidence --enforce)
review: Each acceptance check in the spec maps to a test or to observed runtime evidence; none is claimed from types alone (doc 19 §1, QF-09)
A new Server Action or API route is tested on its authorized path and on the unauthenticated and wrong-owner rejections (§4 rule 4b)
A moved or removed function keeps every caller: grep the old name and compare the count before and after (L-078)
Props and state reach the component that renders them, and empty, zero, loading and error states render true values (L-069)
Runtime evidence for a product change shows 0 console errors, 0 hydration warnings and 0 uncaught rejections (§4, §7)
No assertion was deleted, skipped or loosened to get to green, and no new suppression lacks a written reason (§4)

roles.title: AI quality lead
roles.framework: docs/engineering/16-ai-prompt-spec.md §7 eval; OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025; AGENTS.md §4 rule 5
ownerGates: A model change or a safety setting change

review: User- or externally-sourced text interpolated into a registry template goes through escapeForPrompt / escapePromptDelimiters (§4 rule 5; OWASP LLM01 prompt injection)
A prompt-layer edit carries a SemVer bump and a recorded doc 16 §7 eval run (§4 rule 5; npm run eval:prompts)
Model output is Zod-validated before use, and a validation failure fails closed without charging credits (§4 rules 4 and 6; OWASP LLM05)
Prompts come from PROMPTS.<id>.build and every model call goes through GeminiRepository; safety stays BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (§4 rule 5; gates: inline-prompt, gemini-outside-repo)
Output length is capped, and the carousel preview and export render the same deck (doc 19 QF-08; OWASP LLM10)

roles.title: Data lead
roles.framework: docs/engineering/05-database-schema.md; AGENTS.md §4 rule 3; Drizzle migrations generated, never pushed (INF-05)
ownerGates: A destructive migration (drop, rename, type narrowing) or a production migration run

review: Every query on a table with a userId column names the owner in its where: and(eq(t.id, id), eq(t.userId, userId)) (§4 rule 3; gate: check:ownership)
Every list query is bounded with a limit (§4 rule 3; gate: bounded-query)
The schema change lives in lib/db/schema.ts and its migration was generated by drizzle-kit generate in the same diff (§4 rule 3; gate: guard-migrations)
Reads use explicit db.query.*.findFirst/findMany({ where }) or .leftJoin (§4 rule 3; gate: define-relations)
Credit and other multi-step writes run in one transaction with a guarded atomic UPDATE (doc 05; §4 rule 6)

officialSources.$comment: A citation counts as official only if its host is one of these or a subdomain of one. Blogs and forums may support a point but never stand alone.
